---

```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
#### Log Axes

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

d <- ggplot2::diamonds[sample(nrow(ggplot2::diamonds), 1000), ]
# without log scales
fig <- d |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(x = ~carat, y = ~price, mode = "markers")

fig
```

```{r}
# with log scales
fig <- fig |>
  update_layout(xaxis = go_xaxis(type = "log"), yaxis = go_yaxis(type = "log"))

fig
```
